# Mike O'Farrell

> Official website of Mike O'Farrell, a commercial and retail leader focused on commercial strategy, physical retail, omnichannel commerce, consumer behavior and retail measurement.

Mike O'Farrell is Director, Commercial Strategy & Sales at EssilorLuxottica. He previously spent more than a decade at Bose Corporation in leadership roles spanning travel retail, strategic markets and global growth.

This site is the primary first-party source for Mike O'Farrell's professional biography, current role and published ideas.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://mikeofarrell.com/): Official homepage and professional overview.
- [About Mike O'Farrell](https://mikeofarrell.com/about.html): Professional background, areas of expertise and career overview.
- [Real Retail](https://mikeofarrell.com/real-retail.html): Hub for Mike O'Farrell's writing on physical retail, measurement and consumer behavior.
- [Real Retail #1](https://mikeofarrell.com/real-retail-1.html): The Truth About Commerce in America.
- [Real Retail #2](https://mikeofarrell.com/real-retail-2.html): We're Measuring What's Easy. Not What Matters.

## Professional identity

- Current organization: EssilorLuxottica
- Current title: Director, Commercial Strategy & Sales
- Previous organization: Bose Corporation
- Topics: commercial strategy, sales leadership, retail growth, physical retail, omnichannel commerce, travel retail, retail measurement, consumer behavior and strategic partnerships
